claim: Bellemare, Dabney and Munos published A Distributional Perspective on Reinforcement Learning in ICML 2017, PMLR volume 70, pages 449–458.
C51 models the categorical distribution of discounted returns using 51 fixed atoms, applies distributional Bellman targets and projects to fixed support.
The paper distinguishes contraction in distributional policy evaluation from non-contraction issues in control under the distributional metric.
A mass of 0.6 at 1.4 projected to support atoms 1 and 2 yields 0.36 and 0.24.
locator: Independent pedagogical arithmetic based on linear projection, not experimental data
